Apply a Rename Map to a Dataset

Source: R/read_loa.R
apply_rename_map.Rd

Renames the column itself and every select_multiple child sharing the <old><sm_separator> prefix. Renaming Q78 without rewriting Q78/Economic reasons would sever the parent-child link, and every select_multiple analysis of that question would silently return nothing.

Usage

apply_rename_map(dataset, map, sm_separator = "/")

Arguments

dataset

A data frame.

map

A named character vector: names are the current names, values the new ones.

sm_separator

Select_multiple separator.

Value

dataset with its columns renamed.

Details

The whole map is applied in one pass over the original names, so a map that happens to rename A to B and B to C cannot chain A through to C.
